CustomField.description: Marks the one role a tailored resume treats as the current role. Tick it on exactly one role, and only on a role that is also marked current. Its employer is the current employer in the resume snapshot, and the export fails when no role or more than one role is ticked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick on one current role only. Its employer becomes the current employer on a tailored resume.
CustomField.label: Is Primary Role
